title.hr: Svatko smije zaustaviti rad zbog sigurnosti
title.en: Anyone can stop for safety: from seeing a hazard to the halt

concept.hr: Tko vidi opasnost, odmah viče „Stop!”: poruka kroz lanac kasni ili se izgubi
concept.en: Whoever sees danger calls stop now; a message along the chain is late or lost

summary.hr: Opasnost na setu, tko ju vidi i što učini: poruka putuje do 1st AD-a dok opasnost ne postane nesreća. Uključi i isključi pravilo „svatko smije stati”.
summary.en: A hazard on set, who sees it and what they do: the message races the accident to the 1st AD. Switch the briefing's "anyone may stop" rule on and off.

concept.hr: Pripravnik vidi stativ bez vreće i odmah viče „Stop!”
concept.en: A trainee sees a stand without its sandbag and calls stop at once

title.en: I'll say it at the break

concept.hr: Isti stativ: poruka čeka pauzu, a opasnost ne čeka
concept.en: The same stand: the message waits for the break, the hazard does not

concept.hr: Kabel u izlazu, rečeno kolegi: bez pravila poruka se izgubi
concept.en: A cable in the exit, told to a colleague: without the rule it is lost

concept.hr: Stop koji nije trebao: nekoliko minuta, nitko nije kriv
concept.en: A stop that was not needed: a few minutes, nobody is blamed
